body: Add a résumé or LinkedIn URL. ChainMatch finds live jobs on company boards and shows exactly why each one fits.
Every card has a fit score, the reasons behind it, and the company's real logo. Swipe right to save, left to pass.
Skills, seniority, location, still open: each link between you and the job lights up, so you know why it's worth applying.
Postings are checked against Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable and SmartRecruiters. Closed roles drop out.
Drafted from your real experience in seconds, plus résumé fixes aimed at the jobs you want.
Top 3 matches of every search free. Pro unlocks everything plus a weekly email with new jobs and cover notes.
